name: Modern weapons case
description: Hard-shell weapons case. E opens the modern arsenal (SCAR, AK-74, M4, M16A3, M249, Remington 870, M24, marksman rifle, XD pistol, AR-15, MP7, Scorpion EVO, Uzi, RPG-7, pump shotgun, FN FAL, suppressed .22 pistol, six-shot grenade launcher) for either side; equipping works as at the weapon racks. Their ammunition is in the mixed supply crate.
